INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES — TERMLY EXAM #1
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Mix random languages with no purpose
   B. Avoid speaking to classmates
   C. Only memorise without using the language
   D. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day

2. When practising Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Listening for information, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Listening for information.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Listening for information.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Listening for information.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Listening for information.

3. When practising Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)

----
12. In three clear sentences, explain Writing 5.3.1 Creative writing – Narrative composition and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
